department: Department of Building, Civil and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: Fall: March 1 for international applicants (July 1 for Canadian residents); year inferred for Fall 2027. Apply early because of Canadian and Quebec immigration steps.
deadline.quote: July 1 (Canadian resident) | March 1 (U.S. and international) | Priority will be given to complete applications submitted by the deadline.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: No admission offer until a faculty member agrees to supervise; you may name up to three potential supervisors, and contacting them directly is highly recommended.
supervisor.quote: You may identify up to three potential faculty members in your application form. | An admission offer will not be issued until a supervisor match has been made.

funding.value: Funding packages (awards, TA and RA positions) are offered at admission to most thesis-based PhD students; no guaranteed amount is stated.
funding.quote: Funding packages are generally available for students in thesis-based programs. | teaching and research assistantships are offered at the time of admission to most students to allow them to focus on their research and studies.

entry_route.value: A master's degree with high standing is required; bachelor's holders are normally admitted to the master's first and may transfer to the PhD after at least one term.
entry_route.quote: degree or equivalent with high standing in engineering or computer science, or in a cognate discipline. | After completion of a minimum of one term of full-time study in the Master's degree, they may, upon application, be recommended by the Department

toefl_min.value: Gina Cody School of Engineering and Computer Science: TOEFL iBT 85 with at least 20 in each part (4.5, no section below 4.0, on the new scale); 75-84 means required English courses, below 75 no admission.
toefl_min.quote: 85 with at least a score of 20 in each of the four components | Overall scores below 75: No admission

ielts_min.value: Gina Cody School of Engineering and Computer Science: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall; 6.0 with no part under 5.5 means required English courses.
ielts_min.quote: Overall score band of 6.5 | Overall score of 6.0 and no part under 5.5

notes: Gina Cody School of Engineering and Computer Science.
